description:
The state aid published for one French company in the European Commission transparency register:
grant date, amount or tax-aid bracket, objective, instrument, granting authority (Bpifrance, regions,
ministries) and aid scheme, most recent first, with the total count.

Use this to answer "what public aid did X receive", "did the State fund X".

The register lists aid above a publication threshold only. Some ADEME grants are in both this tool and
the ADEME one: never add the two. Matched on the SIREN, never on the name.

siren.description: The nine-digit SIREN of a French legal entity. Spaces, dots and dashes are accepted. This is not a SIRET: drop the last five digits of a SIRET to get the SIREN.

name: get_french_company_state_aid
title: State aid received by a French company (EU transparency register)
